notes.notes:
The relationship between cats and dogs has always been a peculiar one and that is no exception for our patrolling guard dogs. While the dynamic isn’t hostile, it is a rare to bump into a cat on the village streets, which means that any potential sighting of one will cause a stir among the local guards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/d1a9486e3029adf118c2097293b941f585a2e76b.gif[/img]

So what better way to distract them than with a cat box, a handy jack-in-the-box style toy that winds up and pops out a cool looking cat that meows to boot. The dogs will stop in their tracks, fascinated by the unexpected feline, and you can use that moment to scamper off into a bush or continue your eating spree.

notes.title: Collecting the Zeppoles
notes.notes:
Scattered across the village you will find scrumptious zeppoles hidden, both providing additional food points but also acting as collectibles for you to grab. To find them all, you will have to embrace your inner explorer and take unexpected routes, potentially even backtracking to get to the ones tucked away in particularly tricky spots.  Whether they are hidden under bridges or tucked away on roof tops, these tasty treats are worth your detour, especially if you are achievement hunting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/c1db1ba6b4f85b76a30779e799c5f4765fc46687.gif[/img]

Once you’ve managed to grab a particular one, you won’t have to do it again in the off chance you get caught along the way, though the additional points you get from consuming it might still be worth it.

notes.title: Tools of Choice - Smoke Bomb
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/955b09cfcb283d6ff68d924793da98eb1c7b2a68.gif[/img]

This comically sized smoke bomb may look lethal at first glance, but is in fact completely harmless except for its ability to daze those caught in its cloud. Perfect if you are being chased by several guards and need to duck into a bush without being seen, the smoke allows you to catch multiple dogs in its radius, leaving them temporarily stunned. 

As with any old-world bomb-shaped item, when you throw it you light the fuse, meaning it takes a little time for the bomb to go off. So make sure to consider that in the timing of your toss so you don’t end up missing your perfect shot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/f9a759d1b8c5f613c54c34174a9e05fd7838bc24.png[/img]

notes.notes:

Lead by their fearless leader [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3689059768909245795]Bella Chonki[/url], this rag tag team of woofs are both chaotic and organized at the same time. While they do in general struggle with a short memory span and can get fooled by a strategic retreat into the bushes, their perseverance make up for it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/ef93cdf925e6b196d139066d384328ebe358745f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Tools of Choice - Dog Mask
notes.notes:
[i]“Look at me, I’m just your friendly neighborhood guard dog! Nothing to see here, please move along with your business. Ladidadida.” [/i] These thoughts and more go through our possum and raccoon’s heads as they slip past the guard dogs, mischievous grins hidden beneath their Dog Masks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/c1db1ba6b4f85b76a30779e799c5f4765fc46687.gif[/img]

As the name might suggest, these fashionably silly items allow our chaotic duo to slip by the dogs disguised as one of their own. Just make sure you don’t linger too long, as they do have a limited amount of time they can be used before your trick is revealed and the guards acknowledge you as their foe once again.

notes.title: Tips & Tricks - Getting that Tasty Ending
notes.notes:
To get the tasty ending, you not only need to eat Bella Chonki’s pizza and steal their crown once, but you also need to do it two more times after that. On top of this, once you’ve gotten your first crown, you cannot get caught at any point, or you will lose all of your crowns. Let’s just say the dog guards aren’t fond of things being stolen from their leader. 

This can pose quite a formidable challenge for those unprepared, as it leaves less room for trial and error. As such, here are some of our top tricks for how to get that juicy tasty ending: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/80e5f3c93b0c3362185d01608c4e8bdbf97f3909.gif[/img]

[h2]LAY OF THE LAND[/h2]
Our Tour of the Village posts gave you an introduction to what the various districts look like, but our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3684562604974789152]final post[/url]  talked about what happens in the village between runs. For starters, the streets you will run through are lovingly handcrafted, meaning they won’t move around between each run. Learning what routes work best for you can therefore be crucial in getting to the top of the island in the smoothest way possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/c1d62d0bde2426afc67c28cad6be8e0bb67b53d0.gif[/img]

[h2]KEEP AN EYE ON THE FOOD METER[/h2]
As we talked about in one of our earliest posts, keeping an eye on your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3713827030197912879]food or key meter[/url] can make all the difference when navigating the island. Make sure you have the means to enter the next district either to get further along your path or to get away from a pesky group of guards chasing you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/ef93cdf925e6b196d139066d384328ebe358745f.gif[/img]

[h2]FOOD, GLORIOUS FOOD[/h2]
In order to maintain that meter, you will of course need to shove your face with as much food as you can. This doesn’t only have to mean running around being a walking, screaming vacuum cleaner of all things tasty, but it also means being strategic in what items you are using and what corners of the map you are seeking. For starters, the gigantic meals scattered across the village are an excellent source of tastiness. Secondly, you have items like the magnet that lets you grab food from further away that can be combined with other passive items like the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3689059768930491487]mint[/url], to decrease the time you are chonky after eating too much.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/c18a0af37461ffa13b72aca153d2b95b5c687c06.gif[/img]

[h2]WEAPON OF CHOICE[/h2]
Lastly, to ensure you can maneuver past the guards both at the top of the village but also throughout your journey, make sure you identify what items work best for you. For some, it might be the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3689059768908812011]Energy Drink[/url], for others the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3663166064318784694]Bag of Bones[/url] but regardless of what it is, make sure your active consumable item is the one you prefer so that you don’t accidentally lose all your progress right at the finish line.

notes.title: The Cookbook of the Traumatized Neighbor - Bella’s Gigantic Pizza
notes.notes:
Everyone in town knows of Bella Chonki’s love for this pizza, as there is always a freshly baked one right in front of their shining throne. While the recipe is a well-kept secret and likely the reason why our possum is so eager to steal a bite, the villagers have attempted to recreate the recipe anyway, if nothing else than to claim that they have had a bite themselves. Only Bella and our stealing possum and raccoon know if the taste is accurate. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/80e5f3c93b0c3362185d01608c4e8bdbf97f3909.gif[/img]

For the dough (6 pizzas worth): 
[list]
[*] 850 g of strong flour 
[*] 12g of instant yeast
[*] 550 g of water (105° - 115°F/41°C - 46°C)
[*] 17 g of salt
[/list]
Toppings for Classical quarter: 
[list]
[*] Sauce: Whole canned tomatoes crushed using your hands (the higher quality the better)
[*] Cheese: Buffalo mozzarella (after it has baked)
[*] Fresh basil (for after it has baked)
[/list]
Toppings for Salami quarter: 
[list]
[*] Sauce: Whole canned tomatoes crushed using your hands (the higher quality the better)
[*] Cheese: Mozzarella
[*] Salami of your choice (Bella likes Pepperoni)
[/list]
Toppings for Vegetable quarter: 
[list]
[*] Sauce: Whole canned tomatoes crushed using your hands (the higher quality the better)
[*] Cheese: Mozzarella
[*] Sliced green bell peppers
[*] Sliced black olives (the higher quality the better)
[/list]
Toppings for Tomato quarter: 
[list]
[*] Cheese: Mix of mozzarella and scamorza
[*] Freshly sliced tomatoes (the higher quality the better)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/6f0bdd6fece7c23b072514c7e7b5df7546845a8f.png[/img]

For the dough, you want to mix the flour with the yeast and stir until thoroughly mixed through in a mixing bowl. Next, you’ll want to add the salt and water, but make sure it’s within the acceptable temperature range so you don’t kill the yeast. Start kneading the dough in your preferred method for 5 - 10 minutes until it’s settled into a nice consistency, after which you put it into an oiled bowl and put plastic over it.

If you want to do the faster bulk fermentation method you leave it out for 2 hours before continuing to work with it, while if you want to try the cold ferment, you let the dough rest for 3-5 days in the refrigerator. Once that time is done, divide the dough into 6 equally sized pieces, shaping each into balls in your hands by using the rolling and pinging technique. By the end, they should end up round and taut, after which they are put onto a lightly floured baking sheet and covered to proof for an hour (or 1½ - 2 hours if you are taking them out of the refrigerator). 

Make sure before you continue that you have started preheating your oven to 450 - 500°F or 250°C - 260°C. Also if you have a pizza stone, this is the perfect time to use it. Once it’s time to roll, flour both your surface and the dough and start patting out the dough as wide as possible using your fingers. Remember to leave a small rim so you end up with a crust and continue to slowly stretch it using your knuckles until it is nice and thin and once done, place it on top of a well-floured pizza paddle. 

Now we move onto the toppings. For all but the Tomato quarter, you want to spread a thin layer of your crushed tomatoes onto the dough. Don’t go too thick or it’ll end up soggy. Next, you want to sprinkle on your cheese (except for your Classical quarter) as well as put any of the other toppings that require baking (e.g. the salami, the bell peppers, and the olives).

Finally, it’s time to bake. Put the pizza into the oven for 5 minutes and then check. Add some olive oil if needed to add some nice additional colour and taste, and then put it back in for an additional couple of minutes. Make sure to check regularly. Once you are happy with the colour, take it out and add the last ingredients in the form of buffalo mozzarella and basil to the Classic section and you are officially done.

Give it a second so you don’t burn yourself and there you have it, Bella Chonki’s favourite recipe, or at least as close as we will get to it without stealing it ourselves.

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Bag of Bones
notes.notes:
It’s just a fact of life that all dogs love bones, be they your loyal friends at home or patrolling guard dogs that have learned to walk on two paws. And what can we say, there is something oddly endearing about how happy the guard dogs also get when they manage to grab one of the bones.

notes.title: Bite-sized Tips and Tricks
notes.notes:
It's the start of a new week and we’ve seen a lot of crazy possums running around the village. 

We're sure you've by now discovered all the ins and outs of this island and the adorable creatures that inhabit it. For those who need a reminder of how to navigate through everything the island has to offer and become the sneakiest possum the island has seen, read through our shortened list below or head over to our previous posts that are linked to each topic:
 
[h2]STICKY TRICKY BUSHES[/h2]
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3663166064318593806]bushes [/url]scattered across the island are your best friends, but do require some getting used to to properly master. For starters, if you run into a bush while being seen by a guard, the bush isn’t safe to hide in so the key is to keep running. If you are unsure if they spotted you, keep an out if an exclamation mark is over the push. Second, the pushes have thick foliage and you are a food-loving possum, so if you find yourself stuck in a bush simply try moving harder or longer and you should pop right out. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/ae1157c185c9dbea5d8d0c490851b1f72caacc92.gif[/img]

[h2]DON’T FORGET THE CHECKPOINTS[/h2]
Scattered throughout the village are small caves with P’s over the doorway, and these are in fact [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3713827030198068240]checkpoints[/url]. They don’t automatically unlock though, so make sure to run up to the entrance of the latest one you pass and plant your flag into it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/29736de41f4897afb916a09726a9c70686abd202.gif[/img]

[h2]HOW ITEMS WORK[/h2]
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3713827030198125719]items you unlock[/url] can be split up into three categories and these are: 

1) Active usable items that have a fixed amount tied to them (e.g. energy drinks, bombs, etc) which can be restocked if a floating box contains the items. Note that you can only have one active usable item equipped at any time.

2) Passive stacked items that increase specific stats (e.g. coffee, mint)

3) Wearable passive items, which give various kinds of boosts (e.g. chef’s hat) of which you can only have one equipped at a time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/23c87aee394ec45dd8ba0e0d28bac1473a4a4898.gif[/img]

[h2]CONSUME THE PIZZA, GET THE CROWN[/h2]
The goal for our hungry possum is to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1951230/view/3663166064318792121]get to the top of the island[/url] where the dog leader Bella Chonki sits on their shiny throne. Once you’ve managed to distract and navigate past the guards protecting Bella, your reward can finally be consumed and claimed. Eat the pizza in front of the dog leader’s face and in doing so, have them submit their crown in temporary defeat.

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Crowns
notes.notes:
Everyone in the village knows about Bella Chonki’s crown, as well as two spares if they were ever to lose the one they wear. These crowns are a symbol of power, of grace, of being at the top of the pecking order. Anyone seen wearing the crown should be feared, for they have clearly done something big to earn such a shiny trophy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/12968598690f951a457f4b7251fc1c0009164ebe.gif[/img]

So it should come as no surprise that when you manage to get to the top of the island for the first time and steal the crown straight from Bella’s head, the villagers and guards alike will be cautious and more alert around you. Whenever you activate the crown, you'll scare all surrounding dogs but only for a short while, as they quickly recover. For someone wearing their leader's crown is scary, and who knows what a crowned Possum might do. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/84f46a11469c4980badca1453bf46b1200deecc1.gif[/img]

As you make your second run to the top of the island, the crown will partially help you get up there faster but you must still remain on high alert since if you get caught, you lose your crown and the fear you created in the guards. This happens regardless if you have managed to get one or even two crowns, as the guards will not only steal back the one you are wearing but also any additional ones you might have already set aside at your starting home. And then you’ll need to run all the way back to Bella to steal each crown over again

notes.title: Tips & Tricks - Eat the Pizza, Get the Crown
notes.notes:
Bella Chonki, the illustrious leader of the dogs of this village has already received their own introduction post, but there is also something rather odd about them. For you see, if you manage to get all the way to the top of your island using your amazing hide-and-seek skills, you will find yourself standing in front of Bella themselves. And this might become trickier than you might think. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/5720e2f006ba43dfc6efc8cc8784586e855a7096.gif[/img]

For starters, it’s hard not to overfocus on the massive pizza lying before you, but don’t forget that it’s guarded by all manner of dogs from the patrol. So you’ll need to be smart about what tools you bring to ensure you don’t get caught right before you can dig into your well-earned feast. Second, you have Bella enigmatically sitting on the throne, refusing to budge because who would dare eat the royal pizza?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/f006c82f720c6edd1f2e41b81f51e156606abe03.gif[/img]

Then for the final step, you need to eat every slice for the dog leader to admit defeat and hand over the crown, a symbol to be feared that one will dive more into in our next Steam post. So when it is time to actually face Bella, make sure you come prepared.

notes.title: A Tour of the Village - The Handcrafted Village
notes.notes:
We’ve introduced all the various districts that make up the village in Pizza Possum, but we haven’t yet talked about it as a whole. This quaint and colourful town with its distinct little neighborhoods has been lovingly handcrafted by our 2 developers over at Cosy Computer. And just like any place in the real world, our fictional village is one that remains unchanged with each run and locations won’t switch when you try getting your next crown. 

This allows you to better explore the narrow streets and nooks in hunt for collectibles and the best route to reach Bella, eat their pizza and steal their crown. It'll also come in handy when chasing a new high score, always knowing where to go for the large meals, helping you accumulate as many points as possible. So grab onto your possum hat, and scream and giggle your way through the village streets in hunt for food.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/12968598690f951a457f4b7251fc1c0009164ebe.gif[/img]

notes.title: Tips & Tricks - Tricky Bushes
notes.notes:
We’ve already written a post about how fundamentally useful the bushes scattered around the island are to your hiding endeavors. However, there are also a few sneaky details about them that might catch you off guard or worse, get you caught. So here are a few tips and tricks regarding hiding in bushes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/a0f85068f8a587f8a746fd93f314af31e1b45740.gif[/img]

For starters, while guard dogs have a short attention span, they aren’t stupid. If one of them manages to notice you, a clear exclamation mark will appear over their heads and they will be fast on your heels. If you run into a bush in an attempt to hide in front of their eyes, they will still remember where you are and you will notice a similar mark appear above the bush. This means you are unsafe, and they can still catch you, so running is your only option. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/ae1157c185c9dbea5d8d0c490851b1f72caacc92.gif[/img]

The bushes around the island are also notoriously thick, filled with branches and leaves. While this makes them the perfect cover to hide in, it also means it takes a little extra effort to pop out of them again, as our possum does love to eat. So if you notice yourself struggling to get out of a bush, it’s because you aren’t moving hard enough.

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Gloves
notes.notes:
To avoid getting caught as a mischievous possum, you need to pick your battles and know when to turn tail and run. While most scenarios call for the latter, if you managed to stumble upon a set of boxing gloves in one of the many treasure boxes scattered across the village you can bring the fight to the guard dogs. 

With clear confidence and a route in mind, you can run straight up to any guard dog and bonk them on the head, making them temporarily dizzy and unable to track you. This gives you the perfect opportunity to grab a hard-to-reach snack or to slip into an especially defended area. Just make sure they don’t spot you first when you attempt your bonking. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/8d050051c4cf9fbfaa9f91bcb7f4a0108ee44695.png[/img]

notes.title: A Tour of the Village - Baking District
notes.notes:
It goes without saying that all the scrumptious food scattered around the village must come from somewhere and that somewhere is in fact the Baking District. Filled with brick pathways, earth-toned buildings, and adorable domeshaped ovens, the scent of freshly baked bread is ever-present. 

Everywhere you look there are piles of flour, toasty loaves of bread, pizzas, and other goodies to stuff your face with. Just make sure you come prepared with items, as this district isn’t the easiest to navigate. With narrow pathways and regular patrols, it’ll take a sharp-minded Possum or Raccoon to slip by unnoticed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/0465d6e45b905fa81f9001f36ab7d548a6ee3020.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Mint
notes.notes:
What might at first glance seem like a simple sweet treat, this mint can help our Possum or Raccoon in some unexpected ways. For while it’s more than understandable that both of them want to shove food into their mouths like there is no tomorrow, if they don’t pause between bites they risk bloating up. And everyone knows it’s hard to run when your stomach is as big as a balloon. 

This is where the mint can be the difference between getting caught or getting away, as it lowers the amount of time you stay in your chonky form. The more of these you manage to grab from the floating boxes, the lower your bloated form lasts, meaning you can shove more food into your mouth without consequence. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/fb2697c349d8fb41a56ae5f143c63628e946a83f.png[/img]

notes.title: A Tour of the Village - Graveyard District
notes.notes:
While perhaps not the most chipper of stops in the village, the Graveyard District is still lush and quite beautiful despite its gloomy purpose. In fact, it is likely the greenest of the districts, with chiseled mausoleums, plenty of bushes and a lovely view of the water below. 

On top of this, a common tradition among the villagers is to leave fresh fruit scattered around the district, especially beside the tombs, as a token of respect. Lucky for our Possum and Raccoon, they are fresh enough to eat, making the whole district a veritable smorgasbord of treats.

notes.title: Meet Bella Chonki
notes.notes:
Up until now, you’ve only been introduced to the various members of the dog patrol, but you have yet to meet their fearsome leader. So without further ado, it’s time to roll out the carpet for their majesty Bella Chonki. A lover of gigantic pizza and shiny crowns, Bella Chonki prefers to rein over the peaceful village from their golden throne, guarded by various members of the patrol. Bella prefers to let others do the work for them, as they sit at the peak of the village observing their freshly made pizza. No one quite understands Bella Chonki’s motivations for not eating the freshly baked delicacy, but no one dares ask either.

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Chef’s Hat
notes.notes:
It is a well-documented fact that chefs can understand food on a whole new level than us mere mortals, identifying spices just through scent or being able to create a symphony of flavour through simple combinations. And all it takes to become a chef is to wear a chef’s hat, right? 

So once our Possum or Raccoon dons this mighty Toque Blanche, their comprehension of the food they consume intensifies, and the points they get from it do as well. So if you are chasing a new personal high score, this is definitely the item to equip. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/47933bc0e1863097ff74c3d7b3a3620a3fcd97ff.png[/img]

notes.title: A Tour of the Village - Vineyard District
notes.notes:
One of the largest exports from the village is in fact sunkissed grape juice, which is why they have a whole district dedicated to growing the precious fruit. Covered in vines with perfectly ripe grapes, this is one of the most guarded and also most beloved parts of town, as its precious commodities sell like butter. 

As you can imagine, it also makes for the perfect hunting ground for a hungry Possum and Raccoon, looking to sate their appetite. Hoovering up grapes left and right through rows and rows of vines, you will easily attract attention from the guards but also walk out of there filled to the brim with precious fruit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/7ca68616d4657974d642c21466690d785fb67f3b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet the Detective Guard
notes.notes:
By far the largest of the patrol, these droopy-eared Detectives have the sharpest sense of smell in the group, picking up the scent of sneaky possums and raccoons alike. If you end up too close to them, their powerful noses will notice your presence and these lumbering dogs will slowly start making their way towards you. But don’t let their lack of speed fool you, as the moment they notice you are nearby, they will alert up to four of their colleagues, making it especially difficult for you to get away or hide in a bush. 

So if possible steer away from these Detectives, or if worst comes to worst, make sure to grab items that can help you distract a larger group so you can get away. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/0ce8c1ce62d3a5b63fc51a70bc2e86b9cdf3949c.png[/img]

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Energy Drink
notes.notes:
It’s hard to beat the feeling of drinking something sweet that’s also laced with caffeine. That spike in energy, the feeling of being faster than ever before. Lucky for our mischievous Possum and Raccoon, the Energy Drink doesn’t only taste amazing but can help provide that extra boost to help get out of a sticky situation. 

So next time you need to get away from a patrol of guards or want to quickly zoom past an unsuspecting dog before they catch wind of you, simply chug an Energy Drink and run faster than ever before. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/ee02443f4168f46216424cb68c5bd4f5a6518c67.png[/img]

notes.title: Pizza Possum is a Snackable Experience
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/468ea88d87ba410234779a273c40bec67be9104d.gif[/img]

You’ve heard us describe Pizza Possum as snackable. Bite-sized. Short and sweet. And we do mean this, Pizza Possum is not a very long game.

In a world of long games and open worlds to get lost in, we wanted to offer a palette cleanser. A midnight snack that might at first glance look like a simple grilled cheese sandwich but still manages to satisfy that inner mischievous possum inside of you that you didn’t even know existed.

And that is the way we like it. We wanted to create a condensed mischievous experience that could easily be picked up, enjoyed, and put down in short intervals. In fact, a veteran player could most likely get to Bella Chonki, eat the pizza, and steal their crown as quickly as you could enjoy a pizza in real life. Though it’ll take you a little longer than that to repeat the feat not once but twice more for the tasty ending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/287ab3afba94a99f8a211e29b027b7ce5a59769f.png[/img]

notes.title: The Cookbook of the Traumatized Neighbor - Tiramisu
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/78488b2efe1150e62f77ab0a5770b52e23983fe3.gif[/img]
There are few desserts that can compete with the complex yet humble flavors that go into a Tiramisu. That perfect mix of sweet, bitter and creamy, this coffee-based dessert has grown in popularity for good reason. While at first glance less complicated than the cake, this dessert still has a few pitfalls you can easily fall into, so make sure you keep a close eye on temperatures and textures as you move through the instructions. 

[list]
[*] 5 - 6 large eggs
[*] 500 grams of Mascarpone cheese
[*] 700 ml of coffee, preferably Italian 
[*] 3-5 tbsp of white sugar
[*] 1 packet of Lady Finger biscuits
[*] Cocoa powder
[*] Icing sugar
[*] Optional: Add 55g of a chocolate liqueur 
[*] Optional: Add 55g of a mild amaro
[*] Optional: A few squares of dark chocolate (with nuts if preferred)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/abaeca6d2dc34660cf3b79cc29ded1279382238e.png[/img]

Start by separating the egg yolks from the egg whites in two separate bows. Get a pot of water boiling and then remove it from the heat, as this will be used to pasteurize the eggs. Place the bowl containing the yolks on top of the pot and use a hand mixer to gently whisk them until they reach a maximum temperature of 60°C/140°F. This should take about 1 - 2 minutes, and make sure to check regularly using a termometer. Remove the bowl from the heat and add around 5 tablespoons of white sugar into the yolks, and mix until it’s light and frothy. 

Now it’s time to start heating the egg whites over the same pot of water, mixing it until you get stiff peaks. Add the Mascarpone to the yolk and sugar mixture and integrate it until you get a nice thick cream. Gently fold in the eggs with a spatula into cream, and set aside. 

Brew your coffee and make sure to let cool completely. This is also where you can add your optional liquor or amaro and mix it in with the coffee. Then take your Lady finger biscuits and submerge them for around 3 seconds, letting any stray drops fall off. Move the dipped biscuits to the bottom of a pyrex pan with the sugar side turned down. Repeat these steps until you have a solid later of biscuits, squishing them as needed. 

Pour some of your mascarpone cream mixture on top, spreading it with a spatula so you get an even layer from corner to corner. Sift the cocoa powder on top and then repeat with another layer of dipped biscuits, cream, cocoa, etc. If you want a richer top layer, add your chopped up optional chocolate squares to the top along with the final layer of sifted cocoa powder. Cover the plate with cling wrap and set into the fridge for at least four hours, preferably overnight. And there you have it! A decadent treat that is sure to delight all palettes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/948e534b9d7b030eaffae39ae4de033cd7563b8e.png[/img]

notes.title: A Tour of the Village - Venetian District
notes.notes:
The contrast between the earthy brick tiles and the sparkling clear canals makes the Venetian District one of the most beautiful in the village. There is an ever-present sense of hustle and bustle as villagers and patrol guards alike fill the streets, with fruit stands and more for our dastardly Possum and Raccoon to consume. 

With winding pathways and bridges galore, making a small detour to walk its streets is well worth the trip. Not to mention the district is known for its gigantic spaghetti and meatballs, which is a must-eat for anyone passing through. So make sure you don’t miss it when you are passing through the Posh District, as the detour is a pleasant one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/f576bc56a5a2370e20ddaacff2b13049291b35d6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet the Mini Guard
notes.notes:
Just because the Mini Guard is the smallest in the patrol doesn’t mean they don’t make up for it in stubbornness. While they are incapable of tackling someone as big as our Possum or Raccoon on their own, they will chase after them with an incessant urgency unlike any you’ve seen. By following their targeting and calling attention to themselves, they are often able to get the help of another nearby guard who is large enough to be able to catch one or both of our mischievous protagonists. 

So when you see one, please remember. They might be tiny but they are also fierce, and they won’t stop chasing until you either outsmart them or they call help and are able to get you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/0763d8204bb97fe0d1e8af63177bec0fb8c8c489.png[/img]

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Unlockable Items
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/95c4132abea796d494dca6aa03860d8d367be9b5.gif[/img]

Before we start diving into each of the unlockable items you will be able to use in Pizza Possum, let’s first look at them as a group. As you climb your personal high score and make it further into the village, you will start to unlock more tools to help you navigate tight spots and distract the guards. These can be picked up through various floating boxes scattered around the island and can make all the difference when being chased. 

Items are split up into three categories. The first are active, usable items with a fixed amount (e.g. energy drinks, smoke bombs), which you can refill the amount of by grabbing more from the floating boxes. These are showcased both in the item menu as well as the corner of the screen, and you can only have one active item in use at any time, meaning that if you pick it up, your previously equipped one will be dropped. 

The second is passive stacked items that increase specific stats, like coffees for speed or mints to make your bloated form last for a shorter time. These are automatically consumed, and you can see the amount you’ve eaten in the item menu. 

Lastly, you have wearable passives, which give various boosts, like the chef’s hat that boosts the number of points you get from consuming food or the bandit mask that makes it harder to spot you. Only one wearable passive can be equipped at any given time, you will have to pick and choose which stat boost works best for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/d3b961b2bc0da78f84488c792351497a286f05a4.png[/img]

notes.title: The Cookbook of the Traumatized Neighbor - Wedding Cake
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/97318b6e24a4fd492d7d6fc92c5374eeb1f47f12.gif[/img]

There are many reasons one might want to enjoy a sizeable cake. It might be a milestone birthday or a big promotion at work. Or it might be as simple as the joy of two people getting married. Its beauty and tasty details are entirely in the hands of its baker, so bring out your inner artist when making this recipe.

[b]For the cake (one layer)[/b]
[list]
[*] 250 g unsalted and softened butter 
[*] 250 g  of caster sugar
[*] 4 large eggs
[*] 1 tsp vanilla bean paste or extract
[*] 250 g of  flour
[*] 2½ tsp baking powder
[*] ½ tsp baking soda
[*] ½ tsp salt
[*] Zest of 1 lemon
[/list]

[b]For the mascarpone cream (one layer)[/b]
[list]
[*] 250 ml mascarpone chilled
[*] 60 icing sugar
[*] 175 ml double cream
[*] 1 tsp vanilla bean paste
[/list]

[b]For the crushed pistachio filling (one layer)[/b]
[list]
[*] 250 g unsalted unshelled pistachios
[*] 100 g sugar
[*] 150 ml of double cream
[/list]

[b]Additional Decorative Elements[/b]
[list]
[*] Chocolate Buttercream creates variation
[*] Fresh fruits (strawberries, citrus) provides vibrancy
[*] Additional garnishes (herbs, plants) adds colour
[/list]

[h2]FOR THE CAKE[/h2]
For the cake, it’s always best set up the basics, so simply pre-heat your oven to 180C/350 C and grease two 8″/20cm cake pans, add parchment paper, and set aside. Next you add the softened butter and sugar to the bowl of a stand mixer, and mix until it is fluffy and light. Add the eggs one by one, making sure to whip well after each to ensure even incorporation. This is also when you add the vanilla paste and the zest of a lemon. 

In a separate bowl, add the sifted flour, salt, baking soda and powder, mix and then add it all to the wet ingredients, mixing well and ensuring that the sides of the mixing bowl are scraped down occasionally to incorporate it well. Finally you divide the batter between the two prepared pans, weighing them to ensure they are of equal size, and then bake for 30 - 35 minutes or until your cake tester come out clean. Remove the finished cakes from the oven and set the, on a wire rack to cool for 20 minutes, then remove them from the pan and let them cool completely

[h2]FOR THE CREAM[/h2]
As for the mascarpone scream, whip the mascarpone with icing sugar and vanilla bean paste, stirring for about 1 - 2 minutes until they are well combined. Then add double or whipping cream to the mixture and whip for 2 more minutes until stiff. 

[h2]FOR THE FILLING[/h2]
Finally for the pistachio filling, simply chop up the majority of your pistachios and set them aside. Make sure to save at least a few semi-whole so that you get added texture and crunch. Next, add the sugar to the cream and mix until nice and fluffy. Finally add your pistachios, mix them in gently and you’re done!

[h2]CAKE ASSEMBLY[/h2]
This one is fairly straightforward, but take about ¼ of the mascarpone cream and put it on top of the bottom cake piece. Dap on a nice portion of the pistachio filling and spread it over. Next, you add another dollop of mascarpone cream and level everything with a cake spatula. Cover it with the second cake layer. Next, you cover the entire cake with mascarpone cream and decorate it to your takes. If you scrape more along the edges you will get a “naked” effect, which gives it a more rustic look, while putting on more will create a more classical-looking result. You can then decorate to your heart's content, adding chocolate, fruits, and even flowers if you so wish to create the cake of your dreams!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/5fcb4d668f3d9a153a57d7eb3f3bcbdc51f79308.png[/img]

notes.title: A Tour of the Village - The Posh District
notes.notes:
With pearly white buildings, crystalline pools, and delicious food scattered as far as the eye can see, one can easily understand why this district got its name. Only the richest in the village could afford such decadence, enjoying the view across the water while sitting in their private tubs and nibbling on fruit. 

Lucky for our Possum and Raccoon, it also makes for an excellent pit stop on the way to the ultimate goal - the Gigantic Pizza and snatching the Crown off Bella Chonki's head. A quick dash across these marbled rooftops and through their cafés and you should reward you with treats, items and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/47e55c81e91f777fc1161da78a56c0c8a20b2ae1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet the Junior Guard
notes.notes:
Much the intern of the patrol, the Junior Guard is not only significantly younger than the rest, but is also still trying to get the ropes of what it means to be part of the squad. While slower than its colleagues, the Junior Guard will put all of its heart into catching the Possum, though its lack of experience often hinders them from seeing it through. 

As such, when you encounter these adorable little champs, make sure to give them an extra cheer of encouragement as you race away as fast as you can. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/240a4617fa9c9f0a7f76731480eb8a62b1522c2d.png[/img]

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Checkpoints
notes.notes:
Scattered across the village you will find mysterious little cave entrances with a P clearly marked above the entrance. These are in fact your possum dens and are where you return to when caught by the patrolling dogs. These locations don’t automatically unlock as you work your way through the various districts of the island. Instead, you have to clearly plant your possum flag over the entrance you wish to return to if the worst happens, and you do this by simply running up to the entrance of the cave. Be careful when returning to old districts, either in the hunt of food or to escape the guards, as you can re-activate old checkpoints and end up losing some progress if you get caught. Make sure you don’t forget, or you might end up getting caught close to Bella Chonki’s elusive pizza only to find yourself back by the beach, several districts away. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/2060249a164da7ac0583e9d3be928f24e52e1ce8.png[/img]

notes.title: The Cookbook of the Traumatized Neighbor - Spaghetti Meatballs
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/b51cb3da2d3888499605409def8570d4a81f6be3.gif[/img]

It doesn’t matter what age you are, there are few who can deny the joy of eating a good bowl of spaghetti and meatballs. Deliciously savory, beautifully spiced, and surprisingly satisfying, all wrapped up in one happy meal. This one is more complex than previous recipes, as it not only takes time to make but also to cook. 

[list]
[*] 1 kg of ground meat, either go 50/50 veal/beef or pork/beef
[*] 1 large egg
[*] 1 dl bread crumbs
[*] 2/3 dl milk
[*] 1 dl freshly grated Parmesan
[*] 1 dl finely chopped parsley
[*] 1/2 to 1 tablespoons of olive oil
[*] 3 cloves of garlic
[*] 1 teaspoon chili flakes
[*] 2 teaspoon mixed Italian herbs. This time around I went for 2 parts oregano, 1 part thyme and 1 part sage.
[*] 2 teaspoons of salt (or to taste)
[*] 1 teaspoon freshly ground pepper (or to taste)
[*] 1 batch of the Red Sauce/tomato sauce made in advance
[/list]

See, a much longer list this time. First off, prep your red sauce if you haven’t already, otherwise you will not get any sauce with your meatballs. As for the meatballs, mix the meat, bread crumbs, Parmesan, dried herbs, chili flakes, parsley, garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk the egg and milk in a separate container, mix all the ingredients in the meat bowl, and then incorporate everything, making sure to check the wetness as you go. Just don’t overwork it, as the meatballs will get very dense otherwise. Oh, and fry up a small sample to make sure the seasoning is good. 

And now it’s time to shape the balls, so pick a spoon of your choice, and then roll them into perfect plump spheres. Now into the oven they go, about 5 minutes to then be flipped and back they go for another 5 minutes before you place them into your red sauce. The key is to brown them a bit, but you will also let them stew in the sauce so don’t worry too much about internal temperature. Also, add those meat drippings into your red sauce, leaving no flavor behind! And then it’s time to simmer and pick out your pasta. Boil it to perfection and dig in!

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Keys
notes.notes:
The quaint village where all this takes place was either built by a very paranoid architect or has been updated after the fact to have looming locked gates between each district. Lucky for our mischievous Possum, by simply eating their fill of the food scattered across the village, they are rewarded with a key that helps open up a path that would otherwise be unavailable. 

While it might require some clever scouring for treats, trying to keep an eye on your key meter as you run around is highly recommended to ensure you have the means to unlock a gate you encounter. Since you can’t stack your keys, being aware of how close you are to unlocking the next one can mean all the difference. You never know when a quick dash into a new district might be all it takes to get rid of a particularly insistent guard.

notes.title: The Cookbook of the Traumatized Neighbor - Grilled Fish
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/a910b4e8b6e0bbf1c7b253f15c68d0c5fd537f53.gif[/img]

For villages blessed with a bustling coastline, it’s borderline a crime not to have at least one fish dish that is considered a local favourite. In this case, it has simply been dubbed Grilled Fish, and is a staple in most households. It is as easy to cook as it looks, with a shockingly few number of ingredients involved: 

[list]
[*] 1 whole fish of your choice, gutted, scaled and trimmed
[*] 1½ tablespoons olive oil
[*] 4 spigs of fresh thyme
[*] 4 spigs of fresh rosemary
[*] Lemon slices
[*] Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
[/list]

As for cooking steps, all you need is a good grill or oven, prep it before hand while you clean the fish. After scorring the whole fish, you simply add the lemon, rosemary and thyme into each cavity, season with salt and pepper and then grill on each side for about 7 minutes until done. And there you have it! The village Grilled Fish that is supposed to be enjoyed by the neighbors and NOT the Possum.

notes.title: The Cookbook of the Traumatized Neighbor - Ice Cream Cone 🍦
notes.notes:
Nothing makes you smile more than an ice cream cone in hand and the sun on your face. Whether you make it by yourself or purchase it from the local food stall, no one can deny the sheer joy that ice cream brings. Since we don’t want to have you all stuck in the kitchen on a lovely summer’s day, here is Village Favourite and how we make it: 

2 scoops of vanilla 
2 scoops of chocolate
2 scoops of strawberry
2 scoops pistachio
2 scoops of lemon
A swirl of whipped cream on top scoop
A sprinkling of chocolate chips
A sprinkling of mixed nuts
Morello cherries on each whipped cream swirl

And you’re done! Now eat it fast… before the Possum returns.

notes.title: Meet the Guard Dog
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/9e8be4dfc794ab2e007f9c9e21aad704728e7571.png[/img]
Oftentimes seen humming to themselves, the Guard Dogs are the first of the village patrol you encounter and often make up the bulk of any larger groups. While they have a strong sense of smell, they aren’t the brightest bulb in the box, and can easily be fooled by hiding in a nearby bush or running away as fast as you can. Ever since the Possum made its first appearance, the Guard Dogs’ strong sense of duty and loyalty have helped the village protect their food. 

- 🍕

notes.title: Tools of Choice - The Bush
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285698/6914e41fb29ea6955eedacd38d7f79201be91654.png[/img]
As a Possum ravenous for food, the amount of shelter and help you will find in the village is fairly minimal. You are basically a force of nature ripping through any meal you can get your hands on after all. But if there is one constant source of safety you will have, it’s your friendly neighborhood bushes. 

They may look unassuming at first, and that is exactly the point! Whether you need to monitor the movement patterns of an especially tricky set of guards or find yourself on the run from them, the dense foliage of these shrubberies will provide cover and respite for the hungry traveler.
